description: The figure is a horizontal bar chart illustrating the number of tasks associated with different language-family categories in the context of “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models.” The category axis is the vertical axis, listing (top to bottom) an unlabeled top row (no visible text label), then IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque; the categories are not alphabetical and appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller bars. The value axis is the horizontal axis labeled “# tasks,” shown on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals (0, 10, 20, …, 80) and vertical gridlines aligned to these ticks. Each category has a single solid-colored bar: the unlabeled top bar is a light blue and extends to just under 80 (approximately 79); IE-Romance is a darker blue and reaches just under 50 (about 47); IE-Germanic is light green and reaches the mid-40s (about 44); Uralic is dark green and reaches about 20; IE-Baltic is light pink and reaches about 17; IE-other is red and reaches about 15; IE-Indic is tan and reaches about 10; Semitic is orange and reaches about 8; Turkic is light purple and reaches about 4; and Basque is dark purple and reaches about 3. There is no stacking or grouping within bars, no legend shown, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond their distinct colors.
